# WorkAMA

> WorkAMA is a unified AI platform that combines an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway, a multi-tenant control plane, a knowledge/RAG layer, an Agent family (AMA-Chat/Work/Code/Design), and multi-endpoint clients (Web, desktop, mobile PWA, miniapp, CLI, browser extension) into one stack. [Learn more](http://localhost:20204/)

## Product lines

- **G (Gateway)** — OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway: model onboarding, key management, rate limiting, routing, failover, metering, audit, content moderation. [Gateway overview](http://localhost:20204/gateway/channels) · [Free providers](http://localhost:20204/gateway/free-providers) · [Usage](http://localhost:20204/gateway/usage)
- **P (Platform)** — multi-tenant AI control plane: workspaces, RBAC, SSO/SCIM, knowledge base + RAG, application orchestration, workflows, third-party integrations. [Knowledge](http://localhost:20204/knowledge) · [Workflows](http://localhost:20204/workflows) · [Billing](http://localhost:20204/admin/billing)
- **A (Agents)** — AMA-Chat, AMA-Work, AMA-Code, AMA-Design agent family. [Agents](http://localhost:20204/agents) · [Code](http://localhost:20204/agents/code) · [Tools](http://localhost:20204/agents/tools) · [Automations](http://localhost:20204/agents/automations)
- **C (Clients)** — Web console, desktop, mobile PWA, miniapp, CLI, browser extension. [Chat](http://localhost:20204/chat) · [Help](http://localhost:20204/help)

## Edition tiers

- **Community** — open source, self-hosted via Docker Compose. [Docs](http://localhost:20204/docs) · [Trust](http://localhost:20204/trust) · [Status](http://localhost:20204/status)
- **Pro / SaaS** — single-tenant SaaS for individuals and small teams, Pro ¥99/mo. [Pricing](http://localhost:20204/pricing)
- **Team** — shared knowledge bases, shared keys, multi-seat collaboration, Team ¥499/mo for 10 seats.
- **Enterprise** — private deployment, SSO/SCIM, SIEM integration, high availability.

## API surface

REST API surface with 855+ operations under `/api/v1/...`. OpenAPI spec at `/openapi.json`. Interactive docs at `/docs`.

## Standards

- WCAG 2.2 AA across desktop, mobile, and i18n-en viewports (axe 0 violations on 25+ routes)
- Lighthouse Accessibility 100/100, Best Practices 100/100, SEO 91/100
- 32 baseline documents, 61 functional requirements, 16 nonfunctional requirements, 144 acceptance scenarios, 176 PostgreSQL tables
- 18 workama-* containers in production compose stack
- 3604 pytest passed on the platform-api backend
